result.verdictNote: The resume is dense with quantified, outcome-led bullets. It shows strong client exposure, leadership with stated scope, and explicit selectivity signals. The main risk is the timeline. The Accenture role (Jan 2026 – Present), the ErythroSIGHT role (2023 – Present) and the ANU postdoc (2022 – 2026) all overlap, and the resume never says which are full-time. A few acronyms (IND-enabling, CRC-P, NPV) need unpacking for a non-specialist reader. No hidden or injected content is visible in the text.
